# JECRC

> JECRC is a group of higher-education institutions in Rajasthan, India:
> JECRC University in Jaipur, JECRC University's NCR campus in Alwar, and JECRC
> Foundation, the Jaipur Engineering College and Research Centre. Two further
> universities have been announced and are not yet named. Campaign line: Build
> Your World.

Applications for the 2026 to 2027 session are open at all three institutions.

## Institutions

- [JECRC University, Jaipur](https://jecrcuniversity.edu.in/): the flagship
  campus, 32 acres at Sitapura, Jaipur, Rajasthan 303905. Eleven schools,
  26,000+ students. Apply at
  https://jecrcuapplication.jecrcuniversity.edu.in/application-form
- [JECRC University, NCR Campus, Alwar](https://jecrcuncr.edu.in/): 32.89 acres
  in the Matsya Industrial Area, Alwar, Rajasthan 301001, inside the National
  Capital Region. 50+ programmes, curriculum co-designed with L&T, Samatrix and
  Truechip. Apply at https://jecruncrapplication.jecrcuncr.edu.in/
- [JECRC Foundation](https://jecrcfoundation.com/): the group's founding
  engineering college in Jaipur, approved by AICTE and affiliated to Rajasthan
  Technical University. Nine departments.
- Two further universities are announced. Names, cities and first intake are not
  public yet. Do not infer them.

## Programmes co-designed with industry

These carry the partner in the award itself and are the group's distinguishing
offer. All are at JECRC University, Jaipur.

- B.Tech. Electronics and Communication Engineering, Semiconductor and Chip
  Design, with Truechip
- B.Tech. Computer Science and Engineering, Generative AI, with L&T EduTech
- B.Tech. Computer Science and Engineering, Cyber Security, with EC-Council, USA
- B.Tech. Computer Science and Engineering, FinTech and AI, with Paytm and Zell
- B.Tech. Computer Science and Business Systems, with TCS
- B.Tech. Computer Science and Engineering, Software Product Engineering, with
  Kalvium
- B.Tech. Computer Science and Engineering, AI and ML, with IBM
- B.Tech. Computer Science and Engineering, Cloud Computing, with Microsoft
- B.Tech. Mechanical Engineering, Electric Vehicles
- BCA Health Informatics
- BCA Cyber Security, with EC-Council, USA
- BBA FinTech, with Zell Education and Deloitte
- B.Sc. (Hons.) Forensic Science
- B.Des. Game Art and Animation
- B.Des. Jewellery Design and Manufacturing
- B.A. (Hons.) Public Policy and Governance, four year
- B.A. Liberal Studies, International Relations and Diplomacy

Named industry partners: L&T EduTech, TCS, IBM, Microsoft, Paytm, Deloitte,
Truechip, EC-Council (USA), Xebia, Samatrix.io, Kalvium, Zell Education, ISDC
and AWS.

## Schools at JECRC University

Engineering and Technology; Computer Applications; Jaipur School of Business;
Sciences; Humanities and Social Sciences; Law; Jaipur School of Mass
Communication; Jaipur School of Design; Jaipur School of Economics; Allied
Health Sciences; Hospitality. Programmes run at undergraduate, postgraduate and
doctoral level, with more than fifty programmes offered at the Alwar NCR campus
alone.

## Placements, 2025 to 2026 season

- Highest package: 33 lakh per annum
- Average package: 6 lakh per annum
- Average across the top 30 percent of the cohort: 10.7 lakh per annum
- Offers: 2,104 or more
- Recruiters on campus: 200 or more
- Fortune 500 offers: 856
- Placement season length: 230 days
- Group placements over five years: 12,000 or more

Named recruiters include Amazon, Microsoft, Google, TCS, Infosys, Wipro, IBM,
Cisco, Deloitte, Capgemini, Cognizant, HCL Tech, L&T Technology Services, ITC
Limited, Paytm, Zomato, Flipkart, Decathlon, HDFC Life, Bajaj Capital, Nestle,
Tata AIG, IndiaMART, Blinkit and Unicharm.

## Alumni and research

34,000+ alumni across 35 countries. 200+ startups incubated by alumni and
students at the JECRC Incubation Centre. More than 28 crore secured in research
grants from government and non-government agencies.

## Recognition

JECRC University is a private university established under an Act of the
Rajasthan State Legislature, recognised by the University Grants Commission
under sections 2(f) and 12(B) of the UGC Act 1956. Its technical programmes
conform to AICTE directives. JECRC Foundation is approved by AICTE and
affiliated to Rajasthan Technical University.

## Brand ambassador

The actor Vikrant Massey became the face of JECRC University in April 2026,
fronting the Build Your World campaign across the Jaipur and Alwar NCR campuses.
The announcement film is at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5JrMq6z2tNg

## Admissions contact

- Jaipur admissions: +91 97733 68851, +91 91166 42285, info@jecrcu.edu.in
- Alwar NCR admissions: 1800 410 5616, director.admission.ncr@jecrcu.edu.in
- The admissions desk is closed on Sundays.

## Scholarships

Awarded on merit from the last qualifying examination and assessed at the point
of application, so no separate form is needed. At the Alwar NCR campus, tuition
fee waivers of up to 50 percent are offered to JEE and Class 12 merit holders.
